# roadie_capability (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie capability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_capability" "existing" {
  slug = "incident-responder"
}

output "capability_instructions" {
  value = data.roadie_capability.existing.instructions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier. Provide either id or slug.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifier. Provide either id or slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `current_version` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `instructions` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
